messages.plaintextBody:
May 29, 2026

Mr. Ryan Labrador
Co-Founder and CEO
REVLV Solutions, Inc.

Dear Mr. Labrador,

As organizations in the business process outsourcing sector continue to operate in an increasingly competitive global market, strong internal leadership and effective communication expertise remain vital to organizational growth and success. To support these goals, many companies are investing in continuing education as a strategic way to strengthen employee engagement, improve retention, and develop future leaders within their organizations.

On behalf of the Graduate School, I would like to invite your company to partner with us in developing the next generation of industry leaders. Our graduate programs are designed to equip mid-level professionals and high-potential employees with advanced competencies in strategic communication, leadership, and analytical thinking, which are skills essential for managing stakeholder relations, addressing operational challenges, and navigating issues and crisis communication effectively.

Our graduate programs are as follows:
- Master of Arts in Journalism
- Master of Arts in Communication
- Master in Communication Major in Public Relations and Corporate Communication

Investing in your employees' postgraduate education offers strategic advantages for your organization:
- Enhanced Employee Retention and Morale: Providing opportunities for academic and professional advancement demonstrates a meaningful commitment to employee growth, helping strengthen morale, loyalty, and long-term retention.
- Immediate Workplace Application: Our curriculum combines theory with practical application, enabling employees to apply their coursework, research, and project outputs directly to real-world organizational challenges.
- Leadership Development: Our programs help professionals strengthen the communication, critical thinking, and decision-making skills necessary for transitioning into strategic and executive leadership roles.

We would welcome the opportunity to discuss how our graduate programs may complement your current Learning and Development (L&D) initiatives, including possible corporate partnerships or customized cohort arrangements for your team.

You may also send a representative to our upcoming free Virtual Open House on June 3, 2026, Wednesday, 10:00 to 11:00 a.m., where Vice President for Academics and Dean Dr. Paz H. Diaz will discuss the Graduate School's programs and admissions process.

June 3, 2026 | via MS Teams | 10:00 a.m. - 11:00 a.m

Thank you for your time and consideration. We look forward to the possibility of collaborating with you in empowering the next generation of leaders in your organization.

For registration assistance or inquiries, you may email gs@aijci.com or call +63 2 8743 4321.

Sincerely,
Janess Ann J. Ellao
Director of Student Affairs
Asian Institute of Journalism and Communication
2244 Espana Blvd., Sampaloc, Manila
+63287434321 | aijc.com.ph
